Luminaire_asset.label: Luminaire asset
Luminaire_asset.description: The uCIFI luminaire asset is an object that enables outdoor lighting control software to configure outdoor lamp controllers. It also enables outdoor lamp controllers to send Zhaga D4i or DALI attributes read from the control gears, to centrally managed outdoor lighting control software or asset management systems.

Asset_GTIN.label: Asset GTIN
Asset_GTIN.description: Global trade-in international number used in the Luminaire Asset controlled by the device.

Year_of_manufacture.label: Year of manufacture
Year_of_manufacture.description: Year of manufacture of the luminaire.

Week_of_manufacture.label: Week of manufacture
Week_of_manufacture.description: Week of manufacture of the luminaire.

Nominal_light_output.label: Nominal light output
Nominal_light_output.description: Nominal light output of the luminaire.

Light_distribution_type.label: Light distribution type
Light_distribution_type.description: Enumeration of possible light distribution type, using the Zhaga D4i enumeration. Please refer to ZD4i standard for more details.

Nominal_input_power.label: Nominal input power
Nominal_input_power.description: Nominal input power of the luminaire.

Power_at_minimum_dim_level.label: Power at minimum dim level
Power_at_minimum_dim_level.description: Power at minimum dim level for the luminaire.

Nominal_max_AC_mains_voltage.label: Nominal max AC mains voltage
Nominal_max_AC_mains_voltage.description: Nominal max AC mains voltage for the luminaire to operate.

Nominal_min_AC_mains_voltage.label: Nominal min AC mains voltage
Nominal_min_AC_mains_voltage.description: Nominal min AC mains voltage for the luminaire to operate.

CRI.label: CRI
CRI.description: Color rendering index (0 to 100) of the luminaire.

Luminaire_identification.label: Luminaire identification
Luminaire_identification.description: Luminaire identification as per DiiA/D4i specification part 251 (MB1 extension): 60 ascii character string.

Luminaire_identification_number.label: Luminaire identification number
Luminaire_identification_number.description: Luminaire identification number as per DiiA/D4i specification part 251 (MB1 extension): 20 digit number.
